sentences.text:
Following the acquittal by the Trial Court, the High Court under the impugned judgment, had reversed the acquittal and convicted the petitioners under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act,
1954.
Dr. Singhvi submits that the prescribed procedure under the Act for collection of sample was disregarded and this vitiates the conviction of the petitioners.
Considering the above and the duration of the sentence, I am inclined to allow the application for exemption from surrendering.
Therefore, coercive steps should not be taken against the accused petitioners, in pursuant to the impugned judgment, until the merits of the matter is considered by this Court.

(JATINDER KAUR) (VIRENDER SINGH)
